dm.summary: I made the Lightkeeper account lightkeeper_rue_r4 through the sign-up form. It was new, and sign-up went straight to the Chapter Hub with no console errors. From the hub's New campaign ticket I created "The Gullhaven Chapter" with the code gullhaven-r4, and the site opened the Lightkeeper's Desk. I went through all five desk sections: Roster (the main desk with dispatch, the hourglass, timer, dice and log), Circle (charter, Illumination ring, questions and reports, resources), Notebook, Map and Requests (with its Invite player panel). I also looked at the dispatch's Template mode, and pressed End Assignment once to see its confirm, then backed out with Keep going. The story is not started: nothing is dispatched and tension is 0. I posted the welcome with the code at the table (message #1). I logged four findings: F001 praise (the code stays in the header on every section and the Requests empty state explains how to join); F002 End Assignment is live on a brand-new campaign and its confirm covers the dispatch character counter; F003 the Illumination milestones at 3, 6 and 9 are drawn differently but never explained, and screen readers don't hear that they are milestones; F004 the Field Notes table of contents is a blank page with no empty-state text. One thing I checked was fine: the outline does not show which desk section is active, but the buttons do carry aria-current, so it is not a bug. My memory is in /home/user/play4/memory/dm.md.
dm.for_players: 1. Sign up on the beta site (your username from personas.md). 2. On the Chapter Hub, make your investigator and join The Gullhaven Chapter with the code gullhaven-r4. 3. Wait for the Lightkeeper to approve your join request.
